params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a walnut wood serving tray with a raised rim, walnut wood with natural grain and a matte finish, on a light oak tabletop, hard side light revealing surface micro-texture, rule of thirds composition with the subject on the left third, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k
